scope: Supplied APK 2.19.6.0 arm64 static inspection; not an Android runtime observation; no original server contact

findings.fact: unit_stop_atk checks scene+0x410 >= 5, then sets scene state 0x29; increments counter each check. No HP, hit, or action-completion condition in this branch.
findings.timing: updateEvent calls checkTutorialState at 0x1802678 before state dispatch; 5 battle updates then sixth condition check returns to script. Scene update count, not proven wall-clock milliseconds.

findings.fact: PARAM24 calls EdgeAnimeList::pauseAnime; PARAM25 calls resumeAnime.
findings.script: tuto1.txt:125-155 starts leader, waits unit_stop_atk, pauses, resumes for next ally, pauses again, then resumes and waits battle_end.

findings.fact: PARAM100 third argument none skips UserInfo::setTutoEventID and preserves prior event. clear replaces event with literal clear. MissionScene::scriptEvent resets drop-once byte +0x414 at 0x18190b4 whenever current event is tuto_drop_heart or tuto_drop_battle_crystal.
findings.impact: Do not clear heart-drop event on subsequent none steps; drop allowance resets on each scriptEvent while matching drop event persists.

findings.fact: Matching tutorial drop event returns 100.0 once per scene flag reset, marks +0x414=1; subsequent checks return 0.0. During tutorial BattleUnit getDrop methods delegate to these callbacks instead of normal rate.
tuto6_bat2_drop_crystal creates exactly 15 BattleItemCrystal objects with item type 2, player party target, CCRect(134,130,32,32).
findings.script: tuto9.txt:114-119 drop -> PLAYWAIT1.5 -> getAll with tuto_get_battle_crystal -> PLAYWAIT1.5

findings.fact: BattleItemCrystal::getTargetUnit overrides random active target to party position2 if event is tuto_get_battle_crystal. Target is cached.
findings.impact: 15 magic crystals go to leader at position2; no evidence for filling every ally.

findings.fact: getAll begins each item's movement. getMoveAction uses random delay 0..0.5 divided by CCDirector::getSpeedFactor, 0.6/speed move with EaseIn rate1.2, then completion callback. exitItemMove calls addBattleCrystal. addBattleCrystal starts from 100 internal gauge units, adds passive/buff bonuses, then incSkillGage; no tutorial max-fill branch in inspected path.
findings.impact: Apply BB at each crystal arrival. Current web base starters all have cost15, compatible with normalized +1 per crystal.

findings.fact: Heart target chosen randomly among living damaged party members; fallback random active unit if none damaged. At exitItemMove it computes getHeartCrystalRecover and queues DamageList::setRecover. Base recover is total heal divided by random(3.0,4.2), minimum1 before passive correction; no flat35% found.
After normal HP decrement, when UserInfo::isTutoPlaying and unit getType()==1 (PlayerUnit), remaining HP is clamped to at least1. Enemies are not given this tutorial clamp.
MissionScene::getTutoTarget returns player position2 when play tutorial chapter1; otherwise returns random active player.

TutorialStepScene::initPartyStatus only on chapter1 scans owned current-party units, keeps leader, finds nonleader fire and thunder, reorders leader2/fire0/thunder1, queues DeckEditRequest. No new unit creation, forced level1/2, or explicit 10030/40030 IDs in function.

active_action_end calls active unit isEndAction; player_turn_start/enemy_turn_start test corresponding party isMyTurn; *_turn_end also require BattleManager::isTurnEndwait; battle_end checks scene state0x1a; treasure_start checks state0xb.

The inspected tutorial script handlers start normal actions; no basis found for enemy HP thirds, last-tap forced kill, burst killing all targets, or setting leader HP to58%/23%. Generic damage routines retain RNG/stat machinery. This does not prove absence in every possible upstream data path.
findings.scan: Direct tutorial UserInfo calls scanned in arm64 range0x1040000..0x1168000. decHp survival clamp found; calcAttack/procAttack contain no direct calls to these tutorial APIs.
limits: Same-version tutorial server monster stats/party roster not recovered.
Existing web enemy captures use older GL data; not same-version statistical proof.
No original device frame capture; travel10f and HP counter curve not established.
Normal combat formula parity is outside this bounded audit.
